title: Change in mass of potato against sugar concentration
caption: Illustrative data. The cylinders gain mass in dilute solutions and lose it in concentrated ones; where the line of best fit crosses zero, there is no net movement of water.
alt: A graph of mean percentage change in mass against sugar concentration from 0 to 1.0 mol/dm³. The points fall from about +18% to −24%; a dashed line of best fit crosses zero at about 0.37 mol/dm³.
description: x-axis: concentration of sugar solution, 0 to 1.0 mol/dm³.
y-axis: mean percentage change in mass, from about −25% to +20%.
The points fall steadily as concentration increases.
The line of best fit crosses zero at about 0.37 mol/dm³: no net gain or loss of water there.

checks.name: the line of best fit passes through the mean of the data (a least-squares line)
the line crosses zero where the lesson says
